title: 第18章 你管这叫请客？
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “来，咱们给陆阳同志，呱唧呱唧！”“啪啪啪，啪啪啪，啪啪啪啪！”刚回到三班，周凯东就带头鼓掌，其余人也是一片掌声。先前在阅览室里，陆阳主动喊报告，上去点评。出色的口才，干练的台风，引得现场一片掌声。不仅得到指导员的表扬，还帮周凯东把掉在地上的脸面给捡了起来。但这却整的陆阳有点儿不好意思：“班长，这都是我应该做的。”周凯东摆摆手：“你帮咱们班挽回了颜面，就得受到表扬。这样吧，每个人说个想吃的，我请客。”众人面面相觑，尴尬开口：“班长，你奖励班副就行了，我们啥也没干，还是别了吧？”周凯东摆手：“咱们是一个集体，一荣俱荣，一损俱损。通过今天的事，我也明白一个道理，那就是糟心事越多，越是不能泄气，越是得提升士气！”他直接询问陆阳：“你想吃什么？”陆阳挠挠头：“想，喝可乐。”“喝什么可乐，那玩儿杀精的。喝牛奶，牛奶健康还补钙，适合你这小身板。”“额，那就牛奶吧。”陆阳觉得有被冒犯到，但有的喝总比没有强。周凯东装模作样的用笔在手上记录，随后问向孔垄。“你想吃什么？”“我想吃烧烤。”“烧烤味的薯片是吧？行，知道了。”“......”“你呢。”“班长，我想玩手机。”“看你长得像手机，上一边去！”“到你了？”“我想吃肯德基，喝珍珠奶茶，还有巧克力，达能王子......”“你特么拿我当阿拉丁神灯呢？没有肯德基，只有泡椒凤爪，珍珠奶茶依旧是不健康，换牛奶，达能王子没有，只有高钙饼干！”装模作样的在手上记录下大家想吃的，周凯东转身就打开柜子，从里头翻找出对应的东西。两盒牛奶，一包泡椒凤爪，一包辣条，半包吃剩的饼干。妈的，说让他们选，结果全是周凯东吃剩的！这玩意儿也能叫奖励？也太寒颤人的！“来来来，千万别客气！”“班长，其实就这点儿东西，你完全没必要记手上......”陆阳眼皮子挑了挑，忍不住吐槽道。周凯东哈哈一笑，说是为了营造出个氛围。吐槽归吐槽，但有零食吃，大家还是挺乐呵的。陆阳撕开这包名为“神雕侠侣”的黑白双色辣条。味道和记忆里的差不多，以咸香为主，麻辣倒是次要的。辣条这玩意儿就和部队里的被子一样，贯穿了很多人的学生时代。这会儿价格还挺便宜，五毛一块就能买一包，后来价格逐渐离谱，越卖越贵。周凯东从外头进来，手里多了两包薯片，还是烧烤味的。这是他从隔壁班，班长那里硬生生搜刮来的。看着大家兴高采烈的瓜分零食，两瓶牛奶在好几个之间不断传递，直到最后一滴被榨干，周凯东嘴角也微微扬起。想当初他也如陆阳他们这般无忧无虑，没心没肺，可转眼已在部队奉献了整整十年。人生能有多少个十年？他又能继续在部队里待上几年？就在周凯东恍惚间，陆阳拿着辣条过来。“班长，你不吃吗？”“你们吃吧。”“我特意给你留了两根。”“不用了，你们吃吧，那包辣条前两天刚过期，班长怕闹肚子。”瞬间，宿舍里鸦雀无声，所有人都在用一副非常操蛋的眼神看向周凯东。就连陆阳都想问候一句：周凯东，求求你做个人吧！.......“班副，我有个疑问，禁闭室到底长啥样啊？”“要是个有床有桌的小单间，那还不让他舒服死？”晚上水池边，三班新兵正在洗漱刷牙，纷纷好奇询问。但对于这个问题，陆阳也不大清楚，他还真没特意去了解过这东西。就好像，谁会没事儿闲着蛋疼去搜看守所一日三餐吃点儿啥，住宿环境怎么样？“肯定不会那么舒服，不然怎么叫关禁闭？”“我是觉得，咱在外头吃苦遭罪，那家伙甚至都不用训练，是不是有点儿太安逸了？”“那你犯个错，也去陪他？”“算了吧，我可不想被人戳烂脊梁骨；那小子就是一臭虫，人见人嫌。”“好了别聊了，抓点儿紧，一会儿熄灯了还得加练了。”“啥，真的假的？”“二班好像已经开始了，我刚来的时候已经在那抱头做深蹲了。”大家表情瞬间全都垮了，不断在心里问候丁腾飞的亲人。并真诚的希望，上面能赶紧把这祸害送走，别再给他们添堵了。.......熄灯号已然吹响，但连部办公室里依旧亮着灯。连长高峰夹着烟，心事重重的来回踱步。白天团长在外头开会，临近晚上才回来。指导员已经去做汇报了，现在还不知道是个什么结果。等待过程高峰抽了快半包烟，心情七上八下的，一刻不得安宁。他是既希望这兵退回去，又不希望罚的这么重；因为一旦退兵成为事实，那特三团在他手里就开创记录了。高峰前途受损是小，丢了整个团的脸面是大。这么一支英雄部队，无数年来培养出了那么多优秀尖兵。结果在他手里出了个孬兵，还被退兵了，这简直就是奇耻大辱！外头忽然传来脚步声，没等对方拧动把手，高峰就一把从里头把门打开。看到何镇涛风尘仆仆的从外头进来，还一边叹气一边摆手，高峰的心都凉了半截。“怎么说，到底怎么说？”“我已经跟团长汇报过情况，团长的意思是......奶奶的，能不能给我来杯水，嗓子都冒烟了！”
content_en: "Come on, let's give it to Comrade Lu Yang, croak, croak, croak!" "Plop, tap, tap, tap, tap, tap!" As soon as he returned to class three, Zhou Kaidong took the lead in applauding, and the others also applauded.Previously in the reading room, Lu Yang took the initiative to call out the report and went up to comment.His outstanding eloquence and capable performance attracted a round of applause from the audience.Not only was he praised by the instructor, but he also helped Zhou Kaidong pick up his face that fell on the ground.But this made Lu Yang feel a little embarrassed: "Squad leader, this is what I should do." Zhou Kaidong waved his hand: "You have helped our class save face, so you have to be praised. Let's just say what you want to eat.I'm treating you." Everyone looked at each other and said awkwardly: "Squad leader, you can just reward the class deputy.We haven't done anything, so why don't we say goodbye?" Zhou Kaidong waved his hand: "We are a collective, and we all gain and lose.After what happened today, I also understand that the more troubles you have, the more you can't be discouraged and the more you have to improve your morale!" He asked Lu Yang directly: "What do you want to eat?" Lu Yang scratched his head: "I want to drink.Coke." "What do you want to drink?It's sperm-killing.Drink milk. Milk is healthy and supplements calcium.It's suitable for your small body." Lu Yang felt a little offended, but some milk is better than nothing.Zhou Kaidong pretended to record it with a pen in his hand, and then asked Kong Long."What do you want to eat?" "I want to eat barbecue." "Barbecue flavored potato chips, right? Okay, got it." "..." "What about you." "Monitor, I want to play with my mobile phone." "See you look like a mobile phone, go to the other side!" "It's your turn?" "I want to eat KFC, drink bubble milk tea, and chocolate, Prince Danone......" "Why are you treating me like Aladdin's magic lamp?There is no KFC, only pickled chicken feet, and bubble milk tea is still unhealthy.Instead of milk, there is no Danone Prince, only high-calcium biscuits!" Zhou Kaidong pretended to write down what everyone wanted to eat, then turned around and opened the cabinet to find the corresponding items.Two cartons of milk, a pack of pickled pepper chicken feet, a pack of spicy strips, and half a pack of leftover biscuits.Damn it, I told them to choose, but Zhou Kaidong ended up eating all the leftovers!Can this thing be called a reward?It’s too chilling!"Come on, come on, don't be polite!" "Squad leader, actually it's just this little thing, you don't need to remember it at all..." Lu Yang raised his eyebrows and couldn't help complaining.Zhou Kaidong laughed and said it was to create an atmosphere.Complaints are complaints, but everyone is quite happy to have snacks to eat.Lu Yang tore open the pack of black and white spicy strips called "The Legend of the Condor Heroes".The taste is similar to what I remember, mainly salty, spicy is secondary.Latiao is just like the quilt in the army, it has been used throughout many people's student days.At the moment, the price was quite cheap, you could buy a pack for only 50 cents. Later, the price gradually became outrageous, and the more it sold, the more expensive it became.Zhou Kaidong came in from outside with two more bags of potato chips in his hand, which were still barbecue-flavored.He obtained this from the monitor of the next class.Seeing everyone happily dividing the snacks, and the two bottles of milk being passed between several people until the last drop was squeezed out, the corners of Zhou Kaidong's mouth raised slightly.I think that at the beginning he was as carefree and heartless as Lu Yang and the others, but in the blink of an eye he had dedicated ten years to the army.How many decades can life last?How many more years can he stay in the army?While Zhou Kaidong was in a daze, Lu Yang came over with spicy strips."Monitor, don't you want to eat?" "You guys can eat." "I left two for you specially." "No, you can eat. That pack of spicy strips just expired two days ago, and the monitor is afraid of getting upset." In an instant, there was silence in the dormitory, and everyone looked at Zhou Kaidong with a very fucked-up look.Even Lu Yang wanted to say hello: Zhou Kaidong, please be a human being!..... "Squad deputy, I have a question, what does the solitary room look like?" "If it's a small single room with a bed and a table, wouldn't it make him comfortable to death?" At night by the pool, the recruits of the third class were washing and brushing their teeth, and they all asked curiously.But Lu Yang didn't know much about this issue. He hadn't really gone out of his way to learn about it.Just like, who would have nothing to do and go to the detention center to search for three meals a day and what is the accommodation like?"It's definitely not that comfortable, otherwise what's the name of confinement?" "I think it's a bit too comfortable for us to endure hardships outside and that guy doesn't even need to train?" "Then make a mistake and go accompany him too?" "Forget it, I don't want to have my spine broken; that kid is just a stinker.Everyone hates it." "Okay, stop talking and hold on tight.We have to practice more when the lights are turned off." "What, really?" "The second class seems to have started.When I first came, I was already doing squats with my head in my hands." Everyone's expressions suddenly collapsed, and they kept greeting Ding Tengfei's relatives in their hearts.And I sincerely hope that the higher-ups can quickly get rid of this scourge and stop causing trouble for them........The lights-out signal has been blown, but the lights are still on in the company headquarters office.Company commander Gao Feng held a cigarette and paced back and forth with deep thoughts.The group leader had a meeting outside during the day and didn't come back until evening.The instructor has already made a report, and we don’t know what the result will be yet.During the waiting process, Gao Feng smoked almost half a pack of cigarettes, feeling very anxious and restless for a moment.He wanted the soldier to retreat, but he also didn't want the punishment to be so severe; because once the retreat became a reality, the Third Regiment would set a record in his hands.The damage to Gao Feng's future is small, but the face of the entire group is lost is big.Such a heroic unit has trained so many outstanding soldiers over the years.As a result, he had a coward in his hands and was forced to retreat. This was simply a great shame and humiliation!Suddenly there were footsteps outside. Before the other party could turn the handle, Gao Feng opened the door from the inside.Gao Feng's heart dropped when he saw He Zhentao coming in from outside, sighing and waving his hands."What should I say? What should I say?" "I have already reported the situation to the group leader. What the group leader means is...grandma, can you give me a glass of water? My throat is smoking!"
